**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The Global Leadership Training Lead is responsible for owning the company's leadership and talent training standard, ensuring that people at every career step are equipped with the skills and mind-set for their role. The role owns the leadership curriculum, including the JOE’s leadership development program(s), coaching and feedback modules and team development tools, facilitates Train-the trainer programs, and partners with Operations, Culture and regional T&LD to embed leadership training across operational and office-based career paths. As part of the Talent & Leadership Development team within People & Development, this position shapes how the company builds leaders at scale, supporting the company's purpose and growth ambitions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the leadership training curriculum and set the standard for how leadership is trained at every career step, for operational and office-based roles.

• Develop and own the company's leadership development program(s), scaling them from pilot to company-wide availability at speed.

• Shape the leadership training content standard within the operational training journey together with Operations, ensuring leadership training is consistent from store to office.

• Develop and own coaching and feedback modules and a team development toolbox that become the common leadership toolkit across the organization.

• Ensure training is anchored in the talent development process, leadership standards and the competency framework, applying an approach of growth assignments, coaching by leaders and formal training.

• Facilitate selected leadership programs, especially pilots and new launches, and own and facilitate the train-the-trainer certification for People Business Partners and regional T&LD, ensuring consistent delivery quality across regions.

• Develop content and facilitator materials, aligned with Operations training and Culture on the shared learning platform.

• Define how training impact is measured, linking participation and feedback to talent and performance outcomes, and use insight to guide decisions on the learning portfolio.

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• Passionate about leadership. A standard-setter who works with high autonomy, setting the bar for how we build leaders

• A builder who creates a pilot and take it to company-wide availability at speed

• A facilitator who energises a room, from a bar back room to the office meeting room

• Operationally credible: you know what a busy shift and running a store demands of a leader and design training that fits it

• A partner who cooperates and influences across Operations, Culture, People Business Partners and regional T&LD without needing authority

• Curious and data-led: you want proof that training changes behaviour and results

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 7+ years in leadership development, L&D or talent roles, ideally in global multi-site quick service restaurant, retail or similar front line heavy industry

• Proven track record designing and delivering content and facilitator materials, incl. blended or digital learning for leadership programmes, including coaching and feedback modules

• Hands-on facilitation experience, ideally with train-the-trainer or certification programmes

• Experience measuring training impact and linking it to performance outcomes

• Leadership experience and/or relevant education

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Connected Cars is on an ambitious mission to connect millions of vehicles through real-time data, enabling safer and more sustainable mobility. Our team of ~70 people is driven by a shared belief in community, team effort, and quality solutions.

The Position

As we rapidly scale across international markets, we are looking for a Head of Support & Training. Exceptional support and structured customer training are core drivers of our product adoption. Sitting within the Commercial team, you will lead a dedicated technical product support team of 5, act as a proactive operational bridge for our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to help them translate technical solutions into tangible customer value, and drive the onboarding strategy for 15–20 international Customer Interaction Centre (CIC) stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Team Empowerment & Leadership: Mentor and develop a team of 5 Product Support Specialists (including one fully remote). After our in depth onboarding, you will step back from daily ticket execution to empower the team, delegating ownership of strategic projects and functional areas so they can grow as independent, proactive professionals.

• Proactive Commercial Enablement: Partner closely with Sales & CS, moving beyond reactive troubleshooting to actively equip CSMs with the technical insights and operational backing needed to unlock customer value and drive account expansion.

• Technical Escalations: Serve as the senior escalation point for complex enterprise issues across our hardware, telematics, and app ecosystem, ensuring prompt root-cause resolution.

• Enterprise Partner Governance: Lead the onboarding and training of 15 -20 international CIC and market support leads, ensuring local operations can support our product at scale.

• Zendesk Architecture: Own and optimize our Zendesk setup - designing efficient ticket routing, automation, SLAs, and performance metrics.

• Training Frameworks: Collaborate with Product & Brand Marketing to create scalable training templates and academy materials for internal teams, external CICs, and end-users.

What You Bring

• Support Leadership: A proven track record of leading B2B technical support in a high-growth SaaS, IoT, or tech environment, with a strong focus on fostering team autonomy and delegating project leadership.

• Technical & Commercial Acumen: Comfortable with software integrations, app/hardware diagnostics, and APIs, paired with a strong understanding of how proactive support drives product adoption, customer value, and long-term retention.

• Global Stakeholder Management: Experience working with multinational enterprise accounts and multi-market partner teams.

• Zendesk Expertise: Hands-on experience configuring and administering Zendesk for automated, scalable workflows.

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to translate complex technical realities into clear guidance for both technical and commercial stakeholders.

Why Connected Cars?

• The opportunity to shape a vital support function during a critical phase of international growth.

• A collaborative culture valuing technical rigor and commercial ambition.

• Competitive salary, attractive pension, Friday bars, monthly social events, affordable lunch scheme, and unlimited office snacks.

Connected Cars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

How to Apply

Please apply via LinkedIn with an up-to-date CV. A cover letter is optional, but feel free to add one if there is extra context you’d like to share.

We are seeking applicants with extensive experience taking the lead in complex ERP transformation projects across ERP strategy, ERP sourcing, project and programme management, architecture, and business consulting.

Lead Designer for the world’s most impactful CPR training programs

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Designer who loves great Interaction Design, UX & UI craft, and can also set direction and bring an organisation with them.

At Laerdal, we develop CPR training solutions used by healthcare professionals and organisations around the world, with a mission to help save one million more lives each year by 2030.

We are seeking an exceptional Lead Designer to join our cross-functional product team in Copenhagen, working on the psycho-motor skills experience of RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete. These are cornerstone programs in the collaboration between Laerdal Medical and the American Heart Association, reaching millions of healthcare professionals across the globe.

This is an opportunity to shape experiences that ultimately help people become better prepared to save a life.

The design challenge goes well beyond screens. Learners move between digital instruction, software-guided practice, physical interaction with manikins and training stations, assessment, and certification. Your role is to make that entire experience coherent, intuitive, and effective.

About us

In Laerdal Copenhagen we are around 150 people developing best-in-class digital learning products. We hire people with grit and mission-driven hearts, and by joining us, you will become part of a unique and dynamic workplace that appreciates diversity, authenticity, ambition, and long-term, sustainable solutions.

We are a unique mix of talents, from medical doctors and learning specialists to designers, software engineers and 3D engineers, working with international partners to deliver effective learning solutions.

Some of what we offer

• A collaborative and diverse environment with lots of passion and energy. Our workplace is friendly and casual, located in an old warehouse at Islands Brygge.

• An outstanding teamwork culture driven by the mission of helping save lives.

• Fair compensation.

• Great opportunities for growth and personal development in a global organization

About you

You are an exceptional hands-on product designer who cares deeply about craft. You are equally comfortable defining an end-to-end learner experience, working through a complex interaction, and crafting the final UI that gets built.

You enjoy getting close to users, turning insight into ideas, and making those ideas tangible through flows, prototypes and high-quality screen designs. You have a strong eye for visual and interaction design, and you care about the details that make a product feel intuitive, coherent and polished.

At Lead level, we also expect you to look beyond the individual screen or feature. You can articulate a compelling design direction, bring Product, Engineering and other stakeholders with you, and use prototypes and customer evidence to move the team from discussion to experimentation and implementation faster.

This is a hands-on design role. You will be the designer creating the UX and UI for these products, not someone handing the work over to another designer.

About the role

On this cross-functional team, you will:

• Own the UX and UI design craft for RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete.

• Design the learner experience across digital interfaces, software-guided training and physical interaction with manikins and training stations.

• Create user flows, interaction models, wireframes, prototypes and polished, implementation-ready UI designs using Laerdal’s Life Design System.

• Work closely with Engineering throughout implementation, reviewing the built experience and ensuring that design quality and intent survive through release.

• Prototype early and often, putting tangible ideas in front of learners and customers rather than relying on presentations and specifications.

• Lead discovery and collaborate with a Design Researcher on research and usability testing to understand learner needs and validate solutions.

• Build a deep understanding of healthcare professionals and their CPR learning and certification journeys through direct engagement with learners, instructors and customers.

• Shape and communicate a strong design vision for the products, creating alignment across Product, Engineering, Educational Specialists and other stakeholders.

• Help the team shorten the cycle from idea to prototype, customer test, learning and release.

• Use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping and iteration.

• Travel to the US and other markets to observe training, test solutions and work directly with customers and partners.

Qualifications

• A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent hands-on UX, interaction and UI design craft in shipped products.

• Strong visual design skills and attention to detail, with the ability to take work all the way from rough concept to production-ready interface.

• Excellent prototyping skills, from quick experiments to realistic prototypes suitable for customer testing.

• Deep understanding of user-centered design, with demonstrated experience involving users throughout the design process.

• Experience designing complex digital products where software is part of a broader physical experience is a strong advantage.

• Ability to establish a product or experience design vision and translate it into concrete design work.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders through customer evidence and tangible design proposals.

• An AI-first mindset toward your own design toolchain and cross-functional workflows in the team.

• Experience with healthcare, medical technology, learning products or connected devices is an advantage.

• Willingness to travel internationally, particularly to the US.

If you're passionate about design and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to join our team at Laerdal Medical in Copenhagen. We’re looking forward to receiving your:

• Letter of motivation,

• CV, and

• Portfolio (can be a link to an online resource)

Only applications with all three will be reviewed. Beware that LinkedIn only allows one document upload, so merge them into one, before you hit the APPLY button.

Start date: ASAP.

Are you interested in the intersection of IT, business and finance? As a Business Consultant, you will work with IT solutions supporting banks' corporate credit processes. You will analyze system issues, understand client needs and translate business requirements into technical solutions while building specialized knowledge within banking and corporate credit.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant to join our team, working with IT solutions that support banks' corporate credit processes. You will be involved in the daily operation, maintenance and further development of these solutions, acting as a link between clients, developers and other stakeholders. Your work will involve investigating issues, understanding business needs and ensuring reliable system operations.

You will join an experienced team that will support your onboarding and help you build expertise within corporate credit and IT solutions. Initially, your focus will be on learning the existing solution and its daily operations, with opportunities to take on more responsibility for further development over time.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Handling and analyzing client-reported issues and tickets, investigating problems and identifying their root causes to ensure reliable system operations.

• Maintaining and supporting existing IT solutions while contributing to their continuous improvement and further development.

• Engaging in dialogue with clients to understand their needs and challenges, translating business requirements into clear and actionable tasks.

• Collaborating closely with developers and testers to investigate technical issues, clarify requirements and coordinate solutions.

• Supporting the development and implementation of new functionality through requirements analysis, testing and refinement.

About you

You are curious, analytical and motivated by understanding how IT solutions work and how they support business processes. You enjoy investigating problems, asking questions and finding solutions in collaboration with others. You are comfortable communicating with different stakeholders and can translate complex issues into clear and actionable tasks.

We imagine that you have a relevant educational background and some experience working at the intersection of IT and business. Most importantly, you are eager to learn, take ownership and build specialized knowledge within banking and corporate credit.

As a Product Owner for Rating Engines at RiskPoint, you will own the most data-intensive systems in the portfolio: the rating engines that price the risk, and the portfolio management tooling that gives underwriting leadership a real-time view of exposure, concentration, and performance across lines. This is not a roadmap of screens and forms. It is a roadmap of models, calibration logic, and data pipelines.

You will decide what is a Quick Win, what is a Strategic Bet, and what is a Wildcard worth a flutter, with a meaningful share of the ideas coming from data science and actuarial, not just underwriting. Own the backlog and roadmap for portfolio management tooling, including exposure aggregation, concentration risk, and loss ratio trending

• 
Prioritise using the 5is framework (Inventory, Ideate, Incubate, Implementation, Iteration), scoring ideas against evidence, sponsorship, and sized benefit before they are resourced

• 
Write requirements and acceptance criteria that hold up against a data pipeline and a model, not just a user interface

Partner with data science and engineers on the underlying models, understanding what drives a price change well enough to defend it to underwriting

• 
Define what good looks like for a new pricing factor or model version, and know when it needs data science or actuarial sign-off

• 
Sequence model and feature rollouts across regions and lines of business, from shadow mode through partial live to full automation, based on measured accuracy and error rates

• 
Use AI tools yourself to query rating engine output logs, run quick data explorations, and draft technical requirements against a schema

• 
Own stakeholder communication end to end, briefing leadership honestly about both what has shipped and what is still shaky

Comfort reading model outputs and asking sharp, informed questions about them, even without a data science background yourself

Genuine fluency in agile ceremonies, and the judgement to know when process should flex to reality

Practical, hands-on use of AI tools in your own workflow for requirements, data exploration, or documentation

Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to adjust your register to underwriters, actuaries, data scientists, and leadership

**Genmab’s CMC Writing team is growing, and we are looking for a Senior CMC Writer to support global regulatory submissions across our expanding portfolio.

Your primary focus will be documentation for global Biologics License Applications (BLAs), Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAAs), New Drug Applications (NDAs), and responses to health authority questions during assessment. Working closely with scientific and technical experts, you will transform complex CMC information into clear, accurate, and consistent regulatory submission documents.

You will join a dedicated team of CMC writers collaborating across early and late-stage development, regulatory submission, and lifecycle management. As a senior colleague, you will independently drive writing activities, provide expert review and mentoring, and help improve documentation practices through AI and digital tools.

The position reports to the Director, Head of CMC Writing, and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your responsibilities include:

• Independently authoring and coordinating review of Module 3 CTD sections and supporting source documents covering manufacturing processes and controls, analytical procedures, characterization, specifications, formulation development, stability, and facilities

• Working with CMC Project Managers, subject matter experts, Regulatory Affairs CMC, Quality Assurance, and external partners to resolve review comments and deliver approved documents within agreed timelines

• Serving as a go-to reviewer for scientific accuracy, document quality, consistency, and regulatory alignment, including verification of data against source documentation

• Authoring and coordinating responses to health authority questions and maintaining the resulting updates across submissions and programs

• Supporting late stage initial filings, global roll outs, lifecycle maintenance, including post-approval changes, and contributing to IND/CTA submissions and amendments as needed, while maintaining source document trackers and traceability

• Applying and refining CMC writing and response principles, templates, procedures, and style guides in accordance with Genmab’s quality system and applicable GxP requirements

• Using AI, automation, and digital tools to identify documentation gaps and improve writing quality and efficiency, with critical evaluation of outputs and appropriate handling of confidential information

• Mentoring colleagues in regulatory writing and digital documentation practices, and contributing to process improvements and departmental initiatives

You bring at least six years of experience in CMC or a related field within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and/or medical device industry, with relevant experience in biologics and/or chemical development and manufacturing. We welcome candidates with backgrounds in biologics, small molecules, or both.

**In Addition, You Have

**

• Experience in global regulatory submissions and pharmaceutical or biotechnology product development and manufacturing. Direct experience supporting IND, CTA, BLA, MAA, or NDA filings is expected

• Demonstrated expertise in authoring and reviewing complex CMC regulatory sections and/or supporting source documents, with the ability to independently manage writing activities and guide other authors

• A good understanding of CMC regulatory expectations across development stages and strong knowledge of CTD structure, GxP, and relevant documentation requirements

• Excellent written English, sound scientific judgment, and the ability to present complex information clearly, assess supporting data, and identify gaps and inconsistencies

• Practical experience using AI to improve scientific or technical writing quality and efficiency, including effective prompting, critical assessment of outputs, and verification of scientific content

• Strong communication and influencing skills, enabling you to align cross-functional stakeholders, resolve differing perspectives, and mentor colleagues

• A proven record of ownership, effective prioritization, and timely delivery, combined with curiosity, continuous learning, and a collaborative approach that builds trust, welcomes feedback, and supports an inclusive work environment

**Application deadline: 30 November 2026

**The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. Pelvic organ prolapse affects millions of women, yet many are still left choosing between inadequate conservative options and invasive procedures. Sylvia Health has developed a new medical device designed to offer better support, dignity and quality of life for women living with rectocele prolapse, a major subtype of pelvic organ prolapse.

We are now looking for a Commercial Lead, potentially as a co-founder, to help bring this solution to market. This is a unique opportunity to shape the commercial future of an early-stage women's health company tackling a large, under-served and meaningful problem.

About Sylvia Health

Sylvia Health has developed a novel Class I/IIa medical device for rectocele prolapse support, designed to address an urgent unmet need in pelvic health.

Our aim is to improve quality of life for women who need better options between conservative management and invasive intervention. The product has been developed with a focus on real-world use, comfort, dignity and scalability.

We have developed and patient-tested a medical-grade product, and have recently completed our clinical study at Herlev Hospital. Although we cannot share the full results ahead of publication, we are excited by what we have seen and believe we have developed a compelling solution for the unmet need we set out to address.

We are now focused on preparing regulatory submission, expanding our team, and taking the product to market within the next 18 months. The company is supported by technical and clinical expertise, alongside a strong network of clinical and industry advisors.

Sylvia Health is entering a pivotal phase. The device has been developed and clinically tested, significant funding is in place, and we now need the right commercial co-founder to help shape the path from developed medical device to successful market entry.

This role is a founder-level opportunity to help define the commercial strategy, positioning, partnerships and market access pathway for a new category in women's health.

Shape market positioning, pricing, branding and distribution strategy

Build relationships with healthcare providers, hospital decision-makers, distributors and strategic partners

Help define market access and reimbursement considerations across key markets

Collaborate with technical and clinical functions to ensure product-market alignment

Contribute to fundraising activities, investor conversations and strategic planning

Medical device commercialisation

• 
MedTech go-to-market strategy

Healthcare sales, partnerships or business development

Pricing, distribution, market access or reimbursement strategy

Working with hospitals, healthcare providers or medical device distributors

Major medical device markets, especially Europe

Early-stage company building, fundraising or investor relations

Strong strategic judgement and willingness to operate hands-on

Collaborative working style and appetite for a true co-founder relationship
